en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Muhammad Bin Humran, 
(The narrator) says, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a Christian who testified upon a testimony, then became a Muslim afterwards, would his testimony be allowed?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes. He is in a position to testify’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Najran from Muhammad ibn Humran who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a Christian man who bears a testimony, then becomes a Muslim if his testimony is acceptable.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, he is in the right position to testify.’”
